section.title: Acquisitions
section.para: Collibra has used acquisitions to broaden its platform beyond catalog and governance workflows. Reported acquisitions have centered on data lineage, data quality, analytics workflows, data access, and unstructured data governance.

row.entry: A [[Brno]]-based software company, focused on reverse engineering data lineage from BI Tools and SQL code.
A US-based predictive data quality platform focused on automated data anomaly detection.
A French startup focusing on data notebook acquisition for analytics tools and workflows.
A Belgian startup whose founders had worked at Collibra previously. Dieter Wachters had led Collibra's engineering team for about a decade.
Reported as an acquisition aimed at unstructured data.
